goal: Cache header review: which responses may be stored, for how long, and by whom.
use: Cache header review: which responses may be stored, for how long, and by whom. Use when responses carry cache headers or static assets are deployed.

steps.note: List the response types. Public assets, pages and private data.
Check private data. It must not be cached by shared caches.
Check lifetimes. Static assets with fingerprints can be cached long; pages need short lifetimes.
Check validation. Confirm the validator and the vary header are right.
Report. Each response type with its header, the problem and the fix.
